title: First instruments and early lessons
summary: Rene says the early teacher Professor Dave taught Armstrong and others, and he and Shots took lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: We were wondering, when you first started in music, did you have any lessons? Did you say guitar was your first instrument or how did you get started?

No, no, but you see my brother was locked up in the waveform. You know, talking about Jones. That was Lewis and that boy. They had a little band. Lewis Armstrong had a little band and a man by the name of Dave, he's still living here. They call him Professor Dave. And they used to go back there and lesson. Well I was trying to play the clan that day, you see. And me and a fella by the name of Jimmer Brown and another dog fella played trumpet. Well let's see what his name is. He died there too recently a few years back. Big dog fella. He used to go back there and take lessons. Where did he live? He lived somewhere around Cadena Street.
Did you have another, well there's one guy named Shots back there.

Yeah that's who I'm talking about, Shots. That's who I'm talking about, Shots. Yeah, Shots used to go back there. Well I was trying to fool with clan that then. Now you're coming back, now you're talking about the tailgate. Tailgate time man, one of the bass and the tram owners sitting back on the tailgate. We used to use the furniture wagons. When I first started though they had horses. They used no truck. They used horses because we used to advertise for show down here on N-H street. And they started there, we used to have horses at that time. Then after I began to work for Beans and Rick and Ford and them at the Astro, they called it Tik Tok. We used to advertise the truck.
